messages:
maya: Hey folks — re-requesting quick eyes. Addressed comments on PR #4923: split the change into smaller commits, added a smoke script for the new custom routing fallback, and updated the changelog. PTAL before tomorrow's 10:00am PT merge window. Smoke command below.

maya: ```bash
# run smoke for routing-fallback case
./scripts/smoke.sh --case routing-fallback --iterations 3
# local via docker
docker-compose up --build smoke
```

priya: I'll try to run this now. tiny nit — can you add the required env var to the README (ROUTER_TEST_MODE)?

raul: ran the script on staging once — hit a flake in alloc_race_test. quick log snippet: `AssertionError allocator_test.go:214` — looked timing-related; adding a 50ms jitter made it stable locally.

maya: thanks @raul — pushed a small test tweak to add the jitter and removed the brittle assertion. pushed as a separate commit. PTAL.

ci-bot: Build #4923 passed · unit tests 312/312 · smoke job queued

priya: LGTM aside from README callout. also please squash the debug prints commit before merge. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Merge window at 10:00am PT is clear from infra side (no scheduled maintenance). Make sure someone is merge owner and can rollback if needed.

maya: I'll be merge owner and will be online at 09:50 to watch the rollout. anyone object to merging at 10?

raul: no objections, I can monitor logs during rollout.

priya: added the README env var note in a tiny commit and gave PR an approve. PTAL final @maya

maya: thanks — re-requesting final eyes @priya @raul PTAL
